group_assessment.weighting: 🔴 THE OBSERVATION AND THE INTERPRETATION SEPARATE ALONG A LINE THAT PMID 22634283 DREW AN HOUR EARLIER, AND THE SEPARATION IS THIS READING. THE METABOLIC OBSERVATIONS ARE STRONG AND MULTI-MODAL: glucose uptake by flow cytometry, lactate, Seahorse oxygen consumption, ATP, NADH, NADPH, an independent Metabolon metabolite panel showing raised fructose-1,6-diphosphate with depleted fumarate, malate and succinate, a superarray plus qRT-PCR validation, and the phenotype rescued by HIF1α knockdown in vitro and in vivo. Those converge and do not depend on any single assay. THE BINDING INTERPRETATION IS THINNER THAN THE METABOLISM IT IS ASKED TO EXPLAIN: every WWOX-HIF1α interaction here is a pulldown or co-immunoprecipitation FROM CELL LYSATE, with WW1-dependence established by a mutation (W44F/P47A) that the biophysics literature describes as abolishing WWOX's binding to ALL its partners. No purified binary binding, no affinity, no motif. The metabolic claim would survive a bridged interaction; the mechanistic claim would not.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE INTERACTION IS ATTRIBUTED TO A DOMAIN, NEVER TO A MOTIF, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE WHOLE QUESTION THIS READING WAS SENT WITH. Isolated GST-WW1 constructs precipitate HIF1α from HEK293 lysate. That establishes WW1-DEPENDENCE. It does not establish that HIF1α carries a PPXY ligand, and the paper never claims one: 'PPXY' appears nowhere in the text, and where the Introduction lists WWOX's proline-tyrosine-motif partners — AP-2γ, ErbB4, c-Jun — HIF1α is not among them. PMID 22634283, read an hour before this, measured WW1's requirement as the extended PXPPXYY consensus and showed that three of five genuine PPXY motifs in two real adaptors are not bound at all. INFERENZA: a WW1-dependent association with a protein that has no identified motif is either non-canonical binding or a bridged complex, and this experiment cannot separate them because it is a pulldown from lysate.

entries.proposition: AND THE MUTANT THAT CARRIES THE WW1-DEPENDENCE CANNOT DISCRIMINATE DIRECT FROM BRIDGED, BECAUSE IT ABOLISHES EVERYTHING. Full-length GST-WWOX pulls down HIF1α and GST-WWOX-WFPA does not. But WFPA is W44F/P47A — and PMID 22634283 describes exactly these residues as 'essential for its structural integrity and ligand binding', with the double mutation 'sufficient to abolish interaction of WWOX with its partners'. A mutation that removes all partner binding removes any bridging partner too. PREMISE_TAG: PREMISE: INFERENZA — 'WFPA loses HIF1α therefore WWOX binds HIF1α directly' rests on the unstated premise that no third protein is involved, which this design cannot test.

entries.found_or_sought: sought — checked what the discriminating control actually discriminates

entries.proposition: AND THE MUTATION IS DEFINED IN THE METHODS, WHICH IS WHERE THE OVERLAP WITH THE BIOPHYSICS BECOMES CHECKABLE. W44 and P47 replaced by phenylalanine and alanine. These are the same residues PMID 22634283 identifies as making WW1 a binder — W44 stacking the pyrrolidine rings of the ligand — so the two papers are describing the same structural element from opposite ends, and only one of them measured an affinity.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE DIGOXIN DOSE AS PRINTED CANNOT BE THE DOSE THAT WAS GIVEN, AND THIS IS THE MOST TRACK-C-RELEVANT NUMBER IN THE PAPER. An approved drug, given in vivo to the disease model, rescuing the phenotype — that is exactly the shape a repurposing hypothesis grows from. The legend states 100 mg per kg body weight, intraperitoneally, in 21-day-old mice, with blood glucose read 40 minutes later, n = 3 per group. DIGOXIN IS A CARDIAC GLYCOSIDE WITH A NARROW THERAPEUTIC INDEX AND MOUSE TOLERANCE IN THE LOW MILLIGRAM-PER-KILOGRAM RANGE; the paper's own cited source for digoxin as a HIF1α inhibitor (Zhang et al. 2008 PNAS) used roughly 1 mg/kg/day. A hundredfold above that is not a dose, it is an acute overdose — and an acute cardiac-glycoside overdose perturbs blood glucose by routes that have nothing to do with HIF1α. INFERENZA, and it is a scope limit rather than a refutation: the direction of the reported effect may well be real, but AS PRINTED THE NUMBER CANNOT SUPPORT IT, and this figure must not be carried into a repurposing entry until the dose is confirmed against the published Methods or an erratum. FOURTH CONSECUTIVE DAY that a quantity's meaning has turned on its presentation — hours instead of minutes, a mean above its own threshold, a Z-score called a fold, and now a milligram that should almost certainly be a microgram.
entries.snippet: Digoxin (100 mg/1 kg weight) was injected intraperitoneally (i.p.) in 21-day-old WT and WWOX KO mice, and 40 min later blood was withdrawn for glucose measurement
entries.found_or_sought: sought — a drug dose in a disease model is the number a repurposing track would reach for first, so it is the number to check first

entries.proposition: 🔴 AND THE WHOLE MECHANISM IS NORMOXIA-ONLY, BY THE AUTHORS' OWN MEASUREMENT. Under hypoxia WWOX itself is downregulated, and under hypoxia WWOX no longer affects HIF1α protein levels. So the WWOX-HIF1α axis operates where HIF1α is normally being destroyed and stops operating where HIF1α is normally stabilised. SCOPE LIMIT FOR THIS CORPUS, STATED PLAINLY: any transfer of this mechanism to a brain phenotype has to specify the oxygen tension it assumes, and a hypoxic or ischaemic context is one the paper explicitly measures and excludes.

entries.proposition: THE PAPER DOES NOT DISTINGUISH ITS OWN TWO MECHANISMS, AND SAYS SO. Sequestration of HIF1α away from its promoters, or facilitation of its hydroxylation and degradation — the Discussion offers both as 'two supposed scenarios' and settles neither. Recorded because the two make DIFFERENT predictions for any intervention: a sequestration mechanism is saturable and stoichiometric, a degradation mechanism is catalytic, and a Track C node built on the wrong one would be built on the wrong dose-response.

entries.proposition: THE HYDROXYLATION RESULT, WHICH IS THE STRONGER OF THE TWO SCENARIOS AND STILL CORRELATIVE. HIF1α hydroxylation is reduced in Wwox-KO relative to wild-type MEFs, suggesting WWOX promotes the prolyl-hydroxylation that marks HIF1α for VHL-mediated degradation. The authors immediately name the untested step themselves: whether WWOX acts on PHD2 is undetermined. REVIVAL_TRIGGER for this corpus: any measurement of PHD2 activity or of HIF1α hydroxylation kinetics in the presence and absence of WWOX would convert the stronger scenario from correlation to mechanism.

HIF1α mRNA is comparable between Wwox knockout and wild-type skeletal muscle while HIF1α protein differs, so WWOX is not acting on HIF1α transcription. entries.proposition: AND THE HUMAN CORRELATION, WHICH IS THE WEAKEST LINK IN THE CHAIN AND IS PRESENTED AS THE CLINCHER. A breast-cancer tissue microarray of 80 samples scored by immunohistochemistry for WWOX and GLUT1, reported as a significant inverse correlation at P < 0.05. INFERENZA: an inverse IHC correlation between a tumour suppressor lost in many cancers and a glucose transporter raised in many cancers is consistent with the model and is also consistent with both markers tracking tumour grade. No grade adjustment is reported. The mouse genetics carry this paper; the human array does not add to them.

entries.proposition: 🔴 PANEL 5c SHOWS DIGOXIN LOWERING GLUCOSE IN WILD-TYPE MICE, WHICH THE TEXT DOES NOT MENTION, AND THE TIMESCALE IS INCOMPATIBLE WITH THE MECHANISM THE EXPERIMENT IS OFFERED FOR. The text says digoxin 'caused a fast and specific increase in blood glucose levels SPECIFICALLY in KO mice'. The panel shows both arms moving: under digoxin the knockout rises from about 10 to about 118 mg/dl in forty minutes, and THE WILD TYPE FALLS from about 105 to about 72. Under placebo the knockout stays near 10 and the wild type sits between 128 and 155. So the drug moved wild-type glucose by roughly a third, in the opposite direction, and 'specifically in KO' is not what the figure shows. 🔴 AND THE FORTY MINUTES IS THE HARDER PROBLEM: digoxin is offered here as an inhibitor of HIF1α SYNTHESIS, so any glucose effect through that route requires the loss of existing HIF1α protein and then the decay of its target gene products — GLUT1, PDK1 — whose turnover is measured in hours. A BIDIRECTIONAL SWING OF THIS SIZE IN FORTY MINUTES IS ACUTE PHARMACOLOGY, NOT TRANSCRIPTION. Taken with the printed dose of 100 mg/kg at entries[3] — a hundredfold above the paper's own cited source — the timescale and the dose point the same way, and this figure cannot support a HIF1α-mediated interpretation as published. INFERENZA, and it is a scope limit rather than a refutation of the in-vitro work: the knockdown rescues elsewhere in the paper are genetic and unaffected by this.

entries.proposition: 🔴 THE RESCUE EXPERIMENTS RUN AT TWENTY-THREE TO THIRTY-TWO FOLD OVEREXPRESSION, AND THAT IS THE REGIME ANOTHER PAPER READ TODAY SAYS INVERTS WWOX'S BEHAVIOUR. Three panels display the level of the introduced construct against empty vector: Figure 3b at about 25-fold for WWOX and 23-fold for the WFPA mutant in knockout MEFs, Figure 4d at about 32-fold and Figure 4e at about 28-fold in wild-type MEFs. Every suppression of HIF1α target genes in this paper is measured at those levels. 🔴 PMID 30158849, READ EARLIER TODAY, STATES THAT TRANSIENTLY OVEREXPRESSED WWOX SEQUESTERS TRANSCRIPTION FACTORS IN THE CYTOPLASM WHILE ENDOGENOUS WWOX RELOCATES TO THE NUCLEUS WITH THEM — opposite behaviours for the same protein at different abundance. INFERENZA, and it is the fourth instance of the FT-064 preparation-dependence class in this corpus: the WWOX-HIF1α suppression is established in the overexpression regime, and whether it holds at endogenous abundance is not tested here. The knockout side of the paper is unaffected — loss of function needs no construct.

entries.proposition: ONE OF THE THREE TCA INTERMEDIATES IS NOT SIGNIFICANT, AND THE TEXT LISTS ALL THREE TOGETHER. The Results state 'reduced levels of the TCA cycle intermediates fumarate, malate and succinate'. Panel 2f gives fumarate at P < 0.02, malate at P < 0.02 and SUCCINATE AT P < 0.09 — above the paper's own stated threshold — with visibly overlapping distributions between genotypes. The direction of the metabolic shift is carried by fumarate, malate and fructose-1,6-diphosphate; succinate is listed as if it were equally supported and is not. A small qualification, recorded because a corpus quoting 'fumarate, malate and succinate all reduced' would be quoting one result that the figure marks as not reaching significance.

entries.proposition: AND THE HUMAN CORRELATION RESTS ON FIFTEEN POSITIVE SAMPLES OUT OF EIGHTY. Panel 6e prints the contingency table: WWOX-positive 6 GLUT1-positive against 45 GLUT1-negative, WWOX-negative 9 against 20, at P < 0.05. THE ARITHMETIC HOLDS — recomputed, chi-square is about 4.5 on one degree of freedom, p ≈ 0.03 — SO THE STATISTIC IS NOT THE PROBLEM. What the table shows is that only 15 of 80 tumours are GLUT1-positive at all, and the entire association is carried by how those fifteen split, 6 against 9. Moving two or three samples between cells would remove the significance. Recorded beside entries[10] because it makes the same point quantitatively: the mouse genetics carry this paper and the array is fragile, and now the fragility is a number rather than an impression.
